title: Filesystem Duplicate Finder
prompt:
Implement `find_duplicate_files(root, chunk_size=8192)`. Recursively inspect the regular files below directory `root` and return groups of files with exactly identical bytes. Omit files that have no duplicate.

Read file contents incrementally in chunks no larger than `chunk_size`; do not read an entire file into memory at once. Use a content hash to group candidates. Return a deterministic result: sort paths lexicographically within each group and sort groups by their first path. Each returned path must be a string.

You may assume `root` is an existing directory and `chunk_size` is positive. Use only the Python standard library.

example.reasoning: Only files with the same byte sequence are returned together.
